_purpose: Cannibalization registry: which page owns which keywords. One page = one cluster. No keyword may appear under two pages.
_rule: Checked by seo-tools/runbook/check-cannibalization.mjs — it fails (exit 1) if any keyword is owned by more than one page.
_provenance: National service-page map (Phase A), 2026-06-20. Business-logic grouping informed by KI clustering (order b0574d01, agglomerative/accuracy-2) + 3-tool intent (DataForSEO/Semrush/Ahrefs). SUPERSEDES and DISCARDS the prior PR #107 spoke set. Folds: GBP -> local-seo; technical+ecommerce SEO -> seo; PPC -> google-ads-ppc; GEO+AI -> geo-ai-search; website-maintenance -> web-design; analytics-reporting -> dropped. Geo [service]+[city] = Layer-2 (Phase B), appended later. Detail: seo-tools/runbook/02-page-map.md.

local-seo/toronto._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under local-seo; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY (never the unqualified head, which the national local-seo spoke owns)

seo/mississauga._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under seo (SEO services); CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY (the national seo spoke owns the unqualified heads). Excludes 'local seo mississauga' (-> local-seo/mississauga geo page) and 'dental seo mississauga' (distinct industry intent).

seo/markham._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under seo; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY. DATA-GROUNDED primary: 'seo services markham' is weak here (DFS 50 / Ahrefs 100) so primary = 'seo company markham' (480/500, KD0, the demand bestQuery), NOT templated. Excludes 'local seo markham' / 'local seo company markham' (-> local-seo/markham).

local-seo/edmonton._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under local-seo; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY. Edmonton = Alberta (region AB, geo.region CA-AB). Primary 'local seo edmonton' (480/500, KD0, demand bestQuery — the bare head is strong here).

web-design/hamilton._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under web-design; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY. Primary 'web design hamilton' (Ahrefs 500/KD1, DFS 590 — DFS KD73 inflated by US/NZ Hamilton; Ahrefs ca KD1 is the real difficulty). 'web design services hamilton' is weak (30/10).

local-seo/calgary._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under local-seo; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY. Calgary = Alberta (region AB). Primary 'local seo calgary' (Ahrefs 600/KD0, DFS 320 — demand bestQuery, bare head strong).

seo/brampton._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under seo; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY. Data-grounded primary 'seo company brampton' (390/350, KD0, demand bestQuery — 'seo services brampton' weaker at 170/150). Excludes 'local seo ... brampton' (-> local-seo/brampton, Wave 3).

web-design/london-ontario._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under web-design; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY. London, Ontario (citySlug london-ontario, cityName London, region ON). Primary 'web design london ontario' (390/200, KD0 — the 'ontario' qualifier disambiguates from London UK). company/agency variants weak (~40).

seo/calgary._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under seo; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY. Calgary = Alberta (region AB). Top SEO metro after Toronto — here the service term IS strong: primary 'seo services calgary' (1500/1300, KD20, the demand bestQuery; KD higher 15-36 than GTA suburbs). Excludes 'local seo ... calgary' (-> local-seo/calgary, page #6).

seo/hamilton._role: GEO (Phase B, Wave 1) — city page under seo; CITY-QUALIFIED terms ONLY. Hamilton ON (region ON). Primary 'seo services hamilton' (320/350, KD0, the demand bestQuery; decent service-intent here). Distinct from web-design/hamilton (#5) — seo vs web design qualified.
